# Theory

Source: [`Kernel/Theory.wl`](../../Kernel/Theory.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#theory-kerneltheorywl--definetheory)

DefineTheory: N physical scalars, their MSR response fields, the field order, the space dimension. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Theory".

## Symbols

### `DefineTheory`

`DefineTheory["Scalars" -> {phi1, phi2, ...}, "Dimension" -> Dim]` declares N physical scalars; the response field of phi is created as the symbol phibar (same context). Field order: (phi1, phi1bar, phi2, phi2bar, ...). Returns the "Theory" stage. "Dimension" -> `FixedDimension[2]` declares d = 2 (needed by jac); d is never fixed otherwise.

### `FixedDimension`

`FixedDimension[2]` in `DefineTheory[..., "Dimension" -> FixedDimension[2]]` declares the space dimension d = 2 (required by the Levi-Civita operator jac). Only 2 is accepted.

### `ResponseField`

`ResponseField[theory, phi]` is the MSR response field of the scalar phi.
